title: Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash: what's in it + how to use it #shorts
description:
What's in Dermalogica's Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash, and how Dermalogica says to use it.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Active ingredient: salicylic acid 0.5%
• 8 botanicals including tea tree, lavender and camellia, plus orange peel extract
• Morning and night: a pea-sized amount lathered in wet hands, on face, neck, chest or back; avoid the eyes; rinse with warm water
• Patch test first if you have a known sensitivity to an ingredient
